text_block_list.text:
Following a magnificent display, the
glory of the
Takarazuka Kinen goes to
Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The venue is awash with cheers for a
performance
befitting her title of
Otherworldly Front-Runner.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Seeing the excitement of the crowd, Air
Groove is
struck painfully by the feeling
she can't surpass
Сайленс Судзука.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her composure rattled, Эйр Грув puts
on a
brave face to focus on the Sapporo
Kinen ahead,
but nonetheless leaves the
racecourse dejected.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
